Method of Attack: Replaces the master boot record (MBR) to prevent the operating system from starting and displays a ransom note or other message instead
Locks victim's computers before Windows starts, displays ransom message demanding purchase of SentinelOne antivirus to restore access
Attack Vector: Downloading and installing software from free software and crack sites
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note impersonating Vitali Kremez and MalwareHunterTeam
Message demanding purchase of SentinelOne antivirus
Text messages referencing Vitali Kremez Twitter @VK_intel and MalwareHunterTeam twitter.com/malwrhunterteam
Phone and email contacts disclosed in 'SentinelOne Labs Ransomware' variant
